craft_notes: Sthayin unchanged (song-level pranaya-sama); this verse's color is vertigo-against-stillness: everything whirls (bhram) except the Lord (adhara). Firing structures: (a) mega-compound garbhadhi...vibhrantah packs womb->death->wheel->whirled into one adjectival rush = density/simultaneity -> breathless line 1, w-alliteration (Whirled/womb/wheel); L3's verb-first order kept (vertigo opens the song-line). (b) papraccha perfect (asked-once-for-all, mythic past) -> simple past 'asked' kept, no progressive. (c) (c) adharam 'prop'->'ground': T1/L0 gloss is 'to-support'; 'ground' = substratum, the exact ontological sense, plain and singable. First tried 'stay' — rejected on owner ear-check: primary modern sense is sojourn (plus corsetry), an imported vighna (english-transmission anti-patterns). Same id, diction restoration not doctrine change. (d) paramartham 'highest'->'supreme': restores T1/L0 chosen gloss 'supreme-truth' which L3 had deviated from; re-grounding, documented. (e) 'sorrow's wheel'->'sorrow-wheel': restores duhkhacakra as one compound (beloved hyphen-chain, rule 14). (f) line-1 comma->em-dash: the whirl held across the break, landing still; line 2 end-weights 'the supreme truth' (verb-final release: the asked-thing lands last). Vowel arc: er/oo turbulence -> long stillness (ground/supreme truth). Rupture: dash at line-1 end. Read aloud: falls on TRUTH.
